name: Admin Toolbar Background Color
description: Sets the background color of the classic Admin Toolbar bar (#toolbar-bar) from a single color-picker setting, applied per page load via a small drupalSettings-driven JS behavior.
project_description: The Admin Toolbar BG Color module lets administrators customize the background color of the Drupal Admin Toolbar through a simple configuration form. It provides a color picker to select the desired background color, which is then applied to the toolbar bar so operators get a more personalized (and, in practice, often per-environment) administrative experience. Configure it at admin/config/administration/at-bgcolor. It declares a dependency on the color_field module.
